brand.headline: One place for your cooperative's records.
brand.body: Members, money, stock, sales, meetings and documents — kept together, in English or Kinyarwanda, by the people who run the office.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the account your cooperative gave you.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Give us the email address on your account and we will send you a link.
forgot.sentBody: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Pick something you will remember. You will be signed out everywhere else.
reset.doneBody: Taking you to the sign-in screen.

validation.email: Enter the email address on your account.

changePassword.title: Set your own password
changePassword.description: The password you signed in with was chosen by somebody else. Choose your own before continuing; nothing else opens until you do.
